purpose: Explain measured physiological associations across the qualified library, without reopening failed predictive allocation gates.
primary_cohort: Exactly original fold1 FIT51patients, no new Development/Outer label access. Original80/7635/256 measurement registry unchanged. Other four old overlapping FIT cohorts are audit checks, not extra independent replication.
old_audit: Independently reaggregate original private patient effects: all800 fold-feature-phase estimates,3200 source summaries, Wilcoxon p-values, per-fold160-test BH and operational flags. This is a fixed-effect-row statistical audit, not independent raw-waveform measurement replay. Never overwrite original tables.
new_endpoints: All12 qualified coordinates: four slope/top20 groups each seizure mean and population SD; two crossing groups each mean observed eligible position and eligible crossing rate. No data-dependent endpoint choice. Retained80-125Hz HG and recorded cache-relative time only.
new_effect: Within each patient, signed rank-biserial EZ-vs-NEZ effect2U/(nEZ*nNEZ)-1 using finite values. No channel-level inferential p-values; patient is the replicate. If either finite class is absent, effect missing and coverage reported, not zero. Observed crossing positions estimate a conditional-on-crossing association and must not be called earlier clinical onset.
new_test: Mean patient effect and10000 seed42 patient-bootstrap percentile95% interval; two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, zero_method=wilcox, method=auto, all-zero p1. Exact p-values and finite patient counts reported. BH within all12 new endpoints. Also publish an explicitly exploratory joint172-test BH atlas combining prior160 primary p-values with these12. Do not replace old primary family or call this independent confirmation.
new_source_support: Descriptive source-specific mean/CI and finite n; support rule requires >=3 source strata with >=5 finite patients sharing overall mean direction. No source-specific significance stars or claim of unseen-center validation.
repeated_seizure: Eight endpoints have record-level analogues: four means, two observed crossing positions, two crossing indicators. Recompute per-seizure within-patient effects. Report all finite/zero/nonzero counts. Patient directed agreement is the fraction of ALL finite seizure effects sharing the aggregate primary direction, including zero effects as not agreeing, for patients with>=2 finite seizures. Report the historical direction-agnostic majority fraction excluding zero as a separate diagnostic only. The four across-seizure SD coordinates have no single-seizure analogue and repetition is NOT_APPLICABLE, not passed/failed.
descriptive_flags: New association support: within12 BHq<.05, mean-effect CI excludes0, >=.6 patients share direction and source-support rule above. Additional repeated-direction support only for the eight applicable coordinates: >=10 repeated-seizure patients and median directed agreement>=.7. These flags never select features or authorize fitting.
ledger: Join all32 original group definitions/eligibility/physiology/fold selection with six new groups/12coordinates and the actual conditional result. Preserve original and new source distinctions. Mark unavailable or untested contrasts explicitly. No invented individual feature causal contribution or joint38-group optimum.
adaptivity: Original160 associations and both feature-selection outcomes have already been viewed. New12 association descriptions are specified now; they are exploratory explanation, not an independent test of a predictive winner. Do not change features, roles, thresholds, classifiers, prior p-values or failed gates.
execution: Pinned stable CPU environment, threads1, all source/input hashes fixed before calculations. No model, Raw extraction, classifier metric evaluation, new prediction or Outer run. Preserve private data and prior public releases.
privacy: Only source, hashes and anonymous feature/source aggregates and plots released; labels, identities, patient/seizure/channel effects and runtime logs remain private.
objective_boundary: Association, reproducibility flags and a complete atlas do not establish a stable predictive minimum, irreplacability, surgical SOZ truth or actual Raw/M8 improvement.
